nodes.label: Enhancement Payment System
nodes.rationale: Billed at $25/h x 8h x 5d = $1000/wk, invoiced via Payoneer every Friday and paid same day. A $20.79 withdrawal fee is deducted at withdrawal time, netting $979.21 per invoice; actual bank deposit was $980.00 because a leftover $0.79 Payoneer balance was folded into that withdrawal, not part of the invoice itself.

nodes.label: Implied Real Rate Verification
nodes.rationale: Both loans quote the same 1.5%/mo nominal rate, but backing out the rate implied by the actual quoted payment shows Avanz at ~22.1% effective annual vs Ficohsa at ~27.7% once its 2% disbursement fee is netted in — the nominal rate alone is misleading.

nodes.label: Proposed Allocation of Avanz Surplus to Visa
nodes.rationale: The $771.98 surplus after closing #4 (PriceSmart) and #6 (AMEX Black) is applied directly to Visa rather than held as a cash buffer, since a card's available credit room is limit minus balance — only lowering the balance frees real room; holding cash instead would forgo ~$193/yr in avoided 45% interest for no credit-room benefit.

nodes.label: Muro Final Lateral Derecho Wall Project
nodes.rationale: Planned reinforced-concrete/piedra-cantera perimeter wall (3.35m x 2.60m) estimated at NIO 7,674 excluding formaleta and labor; sized via dry-volume concrete/mortar mix calculations and a confined-masonry staged pour sequence.
nodes.norm_label: muro final lateral derecho wall project

nodes.label: Confined-Masonry Staged Formwork Reuse
nodes.rationale: Because the piedra cantera stone wall forms one side of each column/beam, only the 2 exposed faces need boards; staging the pour (bottom beam, then middle beam + lower column halves, then top beam + upper column halves) lets the same boards be reused across stages, reducing the 5.62 m² contact area down to just 4 physical boards (2 whole for beam faces, 2 cut in half for column faces).
